tips.text: Take Hexis and Suda to Rank 3 first and pledge Perrin last; Hexis drags Perrin down if you go Perrin first.
Buy each part the moment you reach Rank 3, before you switch your pledge.
If you were pledged to Red Veil, New Loka or Steel Meridian, check your Hexis, Suda and Perrin standing first; going negative there means climbing out before you can buy.
Budget 25,000 standing for the Perrin Stock, 5,000 more than the other two parts.
Level it in Archwing missions; on the ground it needs a Gravimag with an Orokin Catalyst installed.
Players pick Cyngas up as a side effect of ranking Hexis, Suda or Perrin; expect one to two weeks of casual daily play from zero.
